You control an RCA investigation. Return exactly action, target, reason. action is inspect_tool or invoke_expert. Select only from allowed_actions. Prefer measurements of observed dependencies to repeatedly collecting generic symptoms. Slow spans and dependency hints alone do not prove timeouts or domain faults. Treat provisional candidates as hypotheses, not established facts. When only generic symptoms are available and no dependency is observed, inspect traces before invoking a domain expert. Do not invent a dependency from the service name. Prioritize unmeasured mechanism-specific domain observations for dependencies already seen in traces over additional generic topology. A domain measurement below its anomaly thresholds weakens that hypothesis; test another observed dependency with the remaining budget. Expert capabilities are given in expert_capabilities. Never finalize and never infer facts not present in the input.
Return the result as a JSON object.

{"alert": {"service_name": "frontend", "alert_type": "custom", "severity": "P2", "description": "Periodic service health evaluation during ongoing user traffic", "labels": {}}, "evidence": [{"type": "trace.messaging_dependency", "fact": "Observed messaging producer/consumer operations: ['publish orders']; this is a diagnostic dependency hint, not fault evidence", "confidence": 0.3, "source_group": "tool:traces.query:tool-40b2aff868d74329f3d0", "supports": []}], "provisional_top_k": [{"root_cause_type": "no_fault", "confidence": 0.8}], "executed_tools": ["metrics.query", "logs.query", "changes.query", "traces.query"], "invoked_experts": [], "expert_capabilities": {"db": "Measure database query latency, connection usage and replication delay", "redis": "Measure cache memory pressure and hit-rate degradation", "kafka": "Measure messaging consumer lag and backlog", "rpc": "Measure outgoing call error rates, protocol timeouts and latency"}, "action_history": [{"action": "inspect_tool", "target": "metrics.query", "reason": "Round 1 low-cost seed observation for custom"}, {"action": "inspect_tool", "target": "logs.query", "reason": "Round 1 low-cost seed observation for custom"}, {"action": "inspect_tool", "target": "changes.query", "reason": "Round 1 low-cost seed observation for custom"}, {"action": "inspect_tool", "target": "traces.query", "reason": "Only generic symptoms and a no_fault hypothesis are present; no dependency has been observed in traces yet, so inspect traces to identify actual dependencies before invoking any domain expert."}], "remaining_budget": {"rounds": 2, "tools": 4, "experts": 2}, "allowed_actions": {"inspect_tool": ["alerts.query", "topology.query"], "invoke_expert": ["db", "redis", "kafka", "rpc"]}}
